name: kestrel-entities-ks
description: Kestrel Consulting project documents: proposals, SOWs, status reports, meeting notes, closing reports and internal memos for customer projects 2023-2026.

ontology.name: kestrel-v2
ontology.value: {"@context":{"owl":"http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#","rdfs":"http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#","ex":"https://schema.search.azure.com/entities#"},"@graph":[{"@id":"ex:Organization","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A company or organization: the consultancy Kestrel Consulting, one of its customers, or a subcontracting partner such as DataForge. Use the full legal or common name, e.g. 'Scaldis Logistics', not 'Scaldis'."},{"@id":"ex:Person","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A named individual: a consultant, a customer contact or a partner employee. Resolve first names, initials and titles to the full name, e.g. 'KV' or 'Koen' to 'Koen Verstraete' only when the context makes it unambiguous."},{"@id":"ex:Project","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A named engagement that the consultancy Kestrel Consulting delivered or is delivering for one customer, e.g. 'Claims Triage Automation'. Use the full project name without customer prefixes. Not a phase, sprint, product or workstream; 'Teams' or 'SharePoint' are technologies, not projects."},{"@id":"ex:Technology","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A named product, cloud service or platform used to build a solution, e.g. 'Azure AI Search', 'Databricks', 'Microsoft Fabric'."},{"@id":"ex:Issue","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A problem, blocker or risk that materially affected a project's schedule, cost or quality, e.g. a delayed security review, a data quality problem, an OT network access delay or a scope change. Summarise it in a short phrase."},{"@id":"ex:Outcome","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A measurable result a project delivered, with its number, e.g. '38% of claims auto-triaged' or '23 leaks detected'."},{"@id":"ex:Place","@type":"owl:Class","rdfs:comment":"A city or country."},{"@id":"ex:worksFor","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Organization"},"rdfs:comment":"The person's employer. Kestrel consultants work for Kestrel Consulting; customer contacts work for the customer. A person can have different employers over time; extract each one."},{"@id":"ex:locatedIn","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Organization"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Place"},"rdfs:comment":"The city where the organization is based."},{"@id":"ex:workedOn","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:comment":"A Kestrel Consulting consultant or a subcontractor employee who is or was on the delivery team of the project, in any role. Customer employees never have workedOn; they use sponsors, productOwnerOf or contactFor."},{"@id":"ex:managedProject","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:comment":"The person who is or was the project manager of the project."},{"@id":"ex:sponsors","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:comment":"The customer-side executive sponsor of the project."},{"@id":"ex:productOwnerOf","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:comment":"The customer-side product owner of the project."},{"@id":"ex:contactFor","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:comment":"A customer employee involved in the project in another role than sponsor or product owner, e.g. IT manager, enterprise architect, security officer, data protection officer or OT engineer."},{"@id":"ex:deliveredFor","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Organization"},"rdfs:comment":"The CUSTOMER organization the project is delivered for (Scaldis Logistics, Mediva Care Group, Fortalis Verzekeringen, Verhaeghe Foods or AquaNova). Never Kestrel Consulting."},{"@id":"ex:deliveredBy","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Organization"},"rdfs:comment":"The consultancy that delivers the project: always Kestrel Consulting for projects in these documents."},{"@id":"ex:subcontractedTo","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Organization"},"rdfs:comment":"A partner organization that delivered part of the project as a subcontractor."},{"@id":"ex:usesTechnology","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Technology"},"rdfs:comment":"A technology the project uses or used in its solution."},{"@id":"ex:followsUp","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:comment":"The project is a follow-up or next phase of an earlier project."},{"@id":"ex:hadIssue","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Issue"},"rdfs:comment":"A problem, blocker or risk that affected the project."},{"@id":"ex:raisedIssue","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Issue"},"rdfs:comment":"The person who raised or imposed the issue, e.g. a security officer requiring a review."},{"@id":"ex:resolvedIssue","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Person"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Issue"},"rdfs:comment":"The person who resolved or worked around the issue."},{"@id":"ex:achieved","@type":"owl:ObjectProperty","rdfs:domain":{"@id":"ex:Project"},"rdfs:range":{"@id":"ex:Outcome"},"rdfs:comment":"A measurable result the project delivered."}]}
